name: Joshua Castaneda
text: Our KitchenAid clear ice maker had been barely making ice for weeks. I'd cleaned it, descaled it, and tried everything I could think of before calling Houston Home Fix. They replaced the pump and water line and got it making clear ice again. When it still wasn't producing like it used to, Serhii came back out and kept looking until he found a piece of paper stuck in the tubing. Plenty of guys would've called it done after the first visit. He stood behind the work, explained what he found, and even checked in afterward to make sure it was still running. Bin is full again and it's working great. Would definitely use Houston Home Fix again.

name: Jorge Eduardo Jaramillo Villegas
text: Houston Home Fix has helped me remotely diagnose a problem with my Kitchenaid refrigerator modelo KSSC48QMS 02 , I was given detailed advice about possible refrigerant leak or sealed system issue to be checked by a local technician since we are located in Colombia , South America . I must mention that the help I received was outstanding , very timely and thorough , my congratulations !!!!

name: Yurii Kolesnichenko
text: Tech Alex fixed my built-in KitchenAid refrigerator on his very first visit! I'm very pleased!

name: Nursaya Temirkhanov
text: Houston Home Fix repaired our 18-year-old built-in KitchenAid refrigerator that completely stopped cooling. We honestly thought the unit was beyond repair, but their technician did an amazing job. He diagnosed a sealed system problem and professionally replaced both the compressor and evaporator. The repair was done carefully and professionally, and now the refrigerator works like new again. It's hard to find technicians who can properly work on built-in refrigerators, but these guys clearly know what they are doing. Highly recommend Houston Home Fix for high-end refrigerator repairs!

name: Natalia K
text: Sergey did an excellent job fixing my dishwasher. He was prompt and great at communicating about his arrival and explaining the actual problem with the appliance. I had gone over a month without it working, so thank you so much Sergey!
